title: Design: Edit Vendor lists the vendor's inactive term last
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop switched off Net 50 while a vendor is on it, and you compare its Edit Vendor dropdown with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Vendor-A} is on Net 50, and Net 50 is deactivated.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-31 Vendor.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p7-07-edit-vendor-keeps-the-inactive-term.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the vendor page of {Vendor-A}.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pencil on the vendor card.
  2. Click the "Credit Terms" box.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "Edit Vendor" window opens with "Credit Terms" reading "Net 50 (Inactive)".
  • Step 2: the list ends with Net 120, the shop's day-of-month terms, Credit Hold, then "Net 50 (Inactive)" last, ticked and highlighted (as in ct-p7-07-edit-vendor-keeps-the-inactive-term.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R3: “A vendor on a deactivated term shows "{name} (Inactive)" on the vendor card's "Credit term" and selected in Edit Vendor, listed after the active terms, until someone picks another.”
